scripts.test: bun test scripts/release.test.ts && bun run --sequential --filter "*" test
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run check:boundaries && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.build:arch: bun run --cwd apps/client tauri build --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu && ./scripts/build-arch-package.sh
scripts.android:init: bun run --cwd apps/client tauri android init
scripts.android:dev: bun run --cwd apps/client tauri android dev
